topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Oh no, I can't believe this happened! I just got home, and there's this package on my doorstep, and it's not even mine. It's for some other person, the one who lived here before me. What am I supposed to do with it? I tried looking for a forwarding address or something, but there's nothing. I feel so bad, what if it's something important? I wish I knew what to do. Maybe I should post something in the neighborhood app? Or just hold onto it and hope they figure it out? I don't want to just send it back to the sender either. This is such a mess.
